coverage.remaining: Not in the scan or not read: No meeting headers appear in the scan for Feb 18, Mar 4, Mar 11, May 20, Jun 17, Jul 1, Jul 22, Aug 19, Sep 9, Sep 30, Oct 28, Nov 11 or Nov 25, 1981; their minutes are not in this volume; No minutes appear for the special meeting set for July 13, 1981; The September 16, 1981 minutes break off during appeal 81-205 (110 Gough Street) with no vote printed, and no outcome for that appeal appears in later meetings in this volume
coverage.note: 1981-01-07 to 1981-12-16. 45 meetings read (35 regular and 10 special, including eight site inspections with no decisions). The April 8 minutes are printed twice in the scan (the second copy headed APRIL ig, apparently April 15) with identical items, counted once; the July 29 minutes are also printed twice verbatim, counted once. The June 3 and June 10 minutes carry a note that they are reconstructed copies, the originals having been lost. Appeals 81-158/159/160 were decided July 15 without an address printed in the minutes, so no rows were recorded for them. Appeals with no building address, and appeals about permits revoked or denied because of alleged criminal conduct, were skipped throughout.
